messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "bones"
set: ["bones", "weakened bones", "weaken bones", "pain in bones", "talk with doctor about protecting bones", "talk with doctor about ways to keep bones healthy", "softening of the bones caused by vitamin D deficiency", "tell your doctor if you have ever had weak bones", "talk with your doctor about ways to keep your bones healthy especially if you are an adult over 50", "broken bone", "calcium", "rickets", "child bone development", "bone loss", "broken bone in spine", "muscle or bone pain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
